title: Vijaye Raji to become CTO of Applications with acquisition of Statsig
summary: Vijaye Raji will step into a new role as CTO of Applications, reporting to CEO of Applications, Fidji Simo, following the acquisition of Statsig.
body: Vijaye Raji will step into a new role as CTO of Applications, reporting to CEO of Applications, Fidji Simo, following the acquisition of Statsig.
summaryZh: 随着OpenAI对Statsig公司的收购完成，Vijaye Raji将出任应用部门首席技术官（CTO of Applications），向应用部门CEO Fidji Simo汇报。

aiReview.reasonZh: 报道了OpenAI收购Statsig及高管人事变动，属于商业并购与人事新闻，缺乏具体模型或大模型技术细节。
